name: Raras Health
what: More than 300 million people live with a rare disease, and most wait years for a diagnosis. Raras Health uses AI and genomics to turn those years into days: we find undiagnosed patients, confirm the diagnosis in our own genomics lab and follow each patient through treatment and lifelong care. Our AI assistant, Rara, already talks to 300+ families a week on WhatsApp.
